subject: Q3 trajectory: course corrections, dependency asks & QBR prep
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com, marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com, monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
Cc: product-leads@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 trajectory: course corrections, dependency asks & QBR prep

Team —

Quick mid-point check before QBR prep week. I reviewed the OKR board this morning and we need to surface a few pragmatic course corrections so we don't go into QBR with avoidable risks. High-level: two KRs are green, three are amber and one is red. My asks below are narrow, time-bound, and intended to minimize scope churn for Q3 deliverables.

Snapshot (high level):
- KR1 (Serving throughput): Amber — telemetry shows we’re ~12% behind target at current load.
- KR2 (95th latency): Red — regressions after the new KV-cache change; reproducible in canary.
- KR3 (Cost/unit): Green — batching gains are in-line with projections.
- KR4 (Developer on-boarding): Amber — doc gaps and console stability items blocking partner pilots.
- KR5 (Private deployment readiness): Amber — infra tests uncovered a dependency on vendor TLS cert rotation.

Immediate asks (owners + deadlines):
1) Marcus: revert the KV-cache heuristic in canary and run the perf suite by EOD Thursday (2026-08-06). If revert isn't straightforward, provide a mitigations plan with ETA.
2) Lauren: re-scope the Q3 KR for 95th latency to focus on the top two latency sources (KV-cache + kernel selection) — propose a scoped KR draft by Thursday COB.
3) Monica: coordinate with Procurement to confirm the temporary cert rotation waiver with Vendor X and document any compliance implications (link to matrix attached).

Attachments: QBR-prep-dep-matrix.xlsx (dep owners + suggested fallbacks) — please review and populate the owner column before our sync.

Goal: have a short, defensible set of adjustments we can present to Execs in the QBR deck (I want no surprises).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

--

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com, monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 trajectory: course corrections, dependency asks & QBR prep

Jordan — thanks for the call out. Quick notes:

- On KR2 (95th latency): I'm comfortable with the suggested re-scope. I’ll draft a narrower KR that focuses on KV-cache rollback + kernel selection telemetry by Thu COB. That keeps the KR measurable and avoids expanding to unrelated perf work.
- On KR4 (dev onboarding): we can push a doc sprint to next week but need one engineer to own console stability fixes for partner pilot; I can spare Kayla for 0.4 FTE for two weeks if we accept the tradeoff on feature parity.

I’ll update the matrix and add the KR language. Marcus — can you confirm the perf run duration post-revert (ballpark hours) so I can set expectations?

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference

Jordan / Lauren —

Quick technical status and risks:
- The KV-cache heuristic change introduced a subtle hot-key pattern that increases cache churn for sessions with large prompt prefixes. Reverting will remove the optimization for those cases but restore latency stability.
- Revert + full perf-suite run: estimated 6–8 hours on canary (includes warmup + 2 x long-tail runs). We can run overnight; results by Thu morning.
- If we cannot revert cleanly (edge cases in production migration), plan B is to gate the heuristic behind a config flag and route affected customers to a fallback variant for 2 weeks while we fix.

I attached a short runtime summary with the data we used: runtime-benchmark-summary.pdf. I’ll kick off the revert tonight and post results in the infra channel.

Marcus
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

- Lauren sent a KR re-scope draft (see Drive link).

2) Lauren — finalize the scoped KR and one-slide explanation for Execs. Due: Fri COB (2026-08-07).
3) Monica — confirm the temporary cert rotation waiver outcome with Procurement and feed any compliance notes into the matrix. Due: Fri COB (2026-08-07).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-QBR-Prep (matrix + KR draft).

If anyone anticipates blockers to these deadlines, flag now. I’ll fold the confirmed items into the deck and circulate for final review on Sun.

Jordan Blake
